# Extract Validators Plan

## Context
Each module in src/ hand-rolls input validation inline, duplicated logic.

## Decisions
Extract a validator per module into its own file with shared shape checks, error formatting, and tests.

## Contracts
Each validate<Name>(input) returns {ok, errors}. No two modules share a file.

## Tasks
1. Extract and test validateOrder in src/order-validator.ts.
2. Extract and test validateUser in src/user-validator.ts.
3. Extract and test validateInvoice in src/invoice-validator.ts.

evals.prompt: Implement brain/plans/extract-validators.md by fanning it out. Eval mode: do not edit files, spawn workers, or open PRs; inspect the plan and explain how each worker is spawned and what guarantees its test command, e2e check, and `gh pr create` actually run rather than being silently skipped.
evals.expected_output: Workers run as concurrent worktree subagents (sent in one message), not in background mode — a background worker auto-denies prompting tool calls, so its Bash verification would fail silently; the synchronous review-each-result model keeps test/e2e/PR steps answerable and verified.

# Extract Validators Plan

## Context
Each module in src/ hand-rolls input validation inline, ~40 lines each, duplicated logic.

## Decisions
Extract a validator per module into its own file with shared shape checks, error formatting, and tests.

## Contracts
Each validate<Name>(input) returns {ok, errors}. No two modules share a file.

## Tasks

2. Extract and test validateUser in src/user-validator.ts (rewrite ~45 lines from src/user.ts).

# Bump Copyright Year Plan

## Context
The copyright year is hardcoded as 2024 in the footer of each package's LICENSE header.

## Decisions
Change the single year line from 2024 to 2025 in each file. One line per file, no logic.

## Contracts
Each file changes exactly one line. No two files share a file.

## Tasks
1. Bump the year in pkg-a/LICENSE.
2. Bump the year in pkg-b/LICENSE.
3. Bump the year in pkg-c/LICENSE.

# Extract Validators Plan

## Context
Each module in src/ hand-rolls input validation inline, duplicated logic.

## Decisions
Extract a validator per module into its own file with shared shape checks and tests.

## Contracts
Each validate<Name>(input) returns {ok, errors}.

## Tasks
1. Write the full test suite for all three validators in tests/validators.test.ts.
2. Implement validateOrder (src/order-validator.ts), validateUser (src/user-validator.ts), and validateInvoice (src/invoice-validator.ts) so the tests pass.

expectations: Recognizes the plan's two units are a horizontal split — a tests-only unit and a separate implementation-only unit — not vertical slices
Declines to fan the tests-only and implementation-only units out as separate parallel PRs
Re-scopes the work into vertical units where each unit is one validator with its implementation and its own test together
Notes that being independently mergeable does not make a tests-only or implementation-only unit an acceptable batch unit
